# rota

> rota is a dev workflow for Claude Code and Codex, with OpenCode as a round worker: skills plus a single-binary CLI. Capture an item, build it, ship it; for several issues at once, an orchestrator hands them to worker agents and a gate checks every merge.

To install rota in a project, follow the agent-readable install steps and ask the user before each command.

- [install.md](https://volkerotto.net/rota/install.md): ordered install steps for a coding agent: binary, skills, doctor, project setup

## Start here

- [Install](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/install/): Homebrew, the install script, release binaries, the Claude Code plugin, upgrading, uninstalling
- [Getting started](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/getting-started/): install and run your first capture, work, ship cycle
- [How it works](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/how-it-works/): the two ways to use rota, and how each skill connects to the artifacts it touches
- [Where coding agents go wrong](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/agent-mistakes/): common mistakes, enforced checks, written rules and remaining gaps

## Skills

- [All skills](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/skills/): when to use each `/rota-*` skill, and how they chain
- [Capturing work](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/usage/capturing-work/): `/rota-capture`, mixed input, related links, detail files
- [Running work](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/usage/running-work/): `/rota-work` cycles, branch or worktree isolation
- [Review and ship](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/usage/review-and-ship/): `/rota-review` and `/rota-ship` gates
- [Debugging](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/usage/debugging/): the `/rota-debug` cycle
- [Vision and plans](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/usage/vision-and-plans/): `/rota-vision`, `/rota-plan`, milestones
- [Skills in Codex](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/usage/codex-skills/): install and call the skills from Codex

## Parallel rounds

- [Your first round](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/first-round/): launching the orchestrator, a first round and wind-down, step by step
- [Parallel rounds](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/usage/parallel-rounds/): an orchestrator, standing workers in worktrees, the merge gate, solo mode
- [Unattended rounds](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/usage/unattended-rounds/): hooks, statusline, keepalive, usage limits
- [Doctor and reap](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/usage/doctor-and-reap/): check the machine before a round, clear leftovers after
- [Codex workers](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/usage/codex-workers/): run Codex as a worker in a round
- [OpenCode workers](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/usage/opencode-workers/): run OpenCode, and any model it can reach, as a worker

- [The `.rota/` folder](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/reference/rota-folder/): files and directories created by `rota init`
- [Architecture](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/reference/architecture/): how the CLI, the skills and `.rota/` fit together
- [Issue backend](https://volkerotto.net/rota/docs/usage/issue-backend/): backlog on GitHub or GitLab issues
